title: bain zainab ka tha alvida alvida
body:
bain zainab ka tha alvida alvida
binte qairul wara alvida alvida
meri aafat zada kaisi aayi qaza
tum pe loundi fida alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
hum ko bin maa ka ab karke haye haye ghazab
qush hue ashqiya'n alvida alvida
dekho uth kar zara haal hasnain ka
kar rahe hai buka alvida alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
hashr ka hai sama chal basi fatima
'mehdi' tu qaak uda alvida alvida
